parsed.explanation: Section 379 directly criminalises cross-dressing (3 months), giving every visibly trans visitor exposure in public. While the conduct statute went unenforced 2018-2022, security forces were documented harassing, arresting, detaining, torturing and beating LGBTQI+ persons across those same years — state-tolerated targeting (tier 2), not merely a dead-letter statute. Official rhetoric (2017 ministerial detention threat, head-of-state hostility) frames LGBTQ people as threats. No hate-crime or anti-discrimination protection exists outside oil and gas; the sole support organisation was raided and closed; most openly LGBTQ citizens fled. Recourse is effectively nil, and torture in custody pushes severity toward catastrophic. Dress-offence enforcement itself is undocumented, so it is not the sole driver — but combined with documented security-force abuse, hostile state framing, and zero remedy, this sits in severe-risk territory alongside the 0.15 anchors.
